dct_title_s: Mapa Československé republiky : podle mirových smluv s Německem a Rakouskem a podle dohodové noty ze dne 13. června 1919
dct_description_sm: Tiskl a vydal >>Melantrich<< Praha II., Václavské 42.
Shows waterways, roads, various boundaries, various territories in transition or dispute between Poland and Czechoslovakia.

Includes handwritten notes and hand-colored illustrations showing operational and non-operational Y.M.C.A. locations, along with boundary lines between Czechoslovakia's three divisions. Dated Oct. 17, 1919. Second copy only shows Y.M.C.A. facilities in process of installation, and is likely an earlier copy. Both maps otherwise identical.
